games.name: [G0Z] Delta Worlds RPG
games.desc:
Public-Alpha V PA 4.9.7 Chaser Route

One day you wake up and your friend Shopkeeper calls you to help him with one little thing: Saving the world... the Earth...
The game has the same world logic as DELTARUNE - there are LIGHT and DARK worlds, which had their balance shift, but three Delta Warriors managed to set up the balance, containing 3 types of worlds: LIGHT, DARK and SHADOWED. But today, SHADOWED worlds have begun to shift the balance... in which the Earth might be at its edge.

This game has Undertale/Deltarune inspired turn-based RPG battle system, with its own story, music, sprites and 3D overworld!
The game was inspired by Undertale/Deltarune by Toby Fox, so go support him!

We highly recommend playing UNDERTALE or DELTARUNE before playing this game to better understand the battle mechanics.

Credits are located in the game's settings.

Delta Worlds RPG © MyRobloxStudio 2023 - 2026

games.name: PROJECT MONSTER
games.desc:
Project Monster Multiplayer is a game in which you will have to work as a team.

There are 2 game modes:
🤠You are a single player: You will play as a team
👹You are the monster: You must kill the other players

There are 3 game modes:
🎁First Mode: You will have to collect 25 boxes and then escape on the train.
🔫Second Mode: You will have to collect boxes and then throw them at the monster to kill it
💊Third Mode: You will have to collect things to deactivate the machine that wants to revive the monster

Rewards (Emeralds):
💰Chests with Like and Group Member goals
💸Codes on our Fan Page
💎Reviving a player will give you gems
👑Staying until the end of the game will give you gems

games.name: ⚔️ Sword Fights on the Heights IV: Reforged
games.desc:
Welcome to Sword Fights on The Heights IV: Reforged, a faithful remake of Shedletsky's classic game.

Reforged aims to bring the Heights back to their former glory — battle on a fixed and expanded map!

⚔️ Fight using classic and new swords: the Earthsplitter, Sky Dagger, Hyacinth, Voidcaller, and Flashbolt!

🥤 Fight with new and revamped power-ups such as the Jet Boots, Bloxy Cola, Slateskin Potion, and Flame Orb.

🔍 Discover hidden badges old and new throughout the map!

🚩 Participate in community events and streaking tournaments.
